integrity: Proof and standalone reproducibility program included. Finite arithmetic tests corroborate, but do not replace, the stated analytic all-parameter argument.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple undirected equal-capacity networks, particular saturating explorability, linear quasi-stationary explorer reduction; no arbitrary directed network, stochastic survival-time, or globally optimal finite rate formula. The general-graph correction is asymptotic; the exact all-rate claim is for stars. Historical priority remains subject to independent research review.
title: A sharp mortality threshold for overexploration on star-shaped metapopulations
